question: What elements are to be included at the end of the root mantra in this formula?
premises: The position is at the end of the root mantra.
The element amāṃ and the term thousand-crore are included.
inference: At the end of the root mantra one includes the threefold tāra, amāṃ, and the thousand-crore designation.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of sahasrakoṭi in this fragment is unclear without the next verse.
plain_english: At the end of the root mantra, after the three tāras, include amāṃ and thousand-crore.
